name: LIHEAP (help with energy bills)
administeredBy: HHS, through state and tribal agencies
valueBasis: A payment toward heating or cooling bills, the size of which the state sets.

criteria.instructions: Does the household pay for home heating or cooling, either as a bill or as part of the rent?
criteria.askIfUnsure: Do you pay for heating or cooling, either directly or through your rent?

criteria.true: yes, the household pays for home energy
